entries.text: Agent governance docs say what an agent does when a required gate is broken by `develop`: reproduce on current `develop`, record the evidence, prepare the repair PR, report and stop, arming and merging nothing. The owner alone relaxes the ruleset, merges the repair PR and restores the ruleset right after the attempt, under a new decision record; the agent then runs a read-only check (`docs/agent/emergency-merge.md`).
